info.title: Portway backend — foundation
info.description: Control API plus execution state foundation. Run admission intentionally returns 503 until Runtime, capabilities and dispatch fencing are implemented. Execution read/stop routes require the optional execution profile. SSE, approvals, model/tool dispatch, MCP, FCM and packages remain unimplemented. Full readyz stays 503.
